title: A module with compatible local identifications
statement: For a scheme X, a ring object R in abelian pro-etale sheaves, an internal R-module Q (the internal-module convention of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category]), a cover U [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering], local modules L_i over R|Ui and maps q_i:L_i→Q|Ui, LocalSubmoduleGluingData consists of an actual global R-module P, a map P→Q, local module isomorphisms P|Ui≅L_i, and equations saying the restricted map is the local isomorphism followed by q_i. This is a structure of data and equations, with no existence assertion.

proof.text: Package the global module, map, local comparisons, and equations as the fields of an ordinary Lean structure; no data or law is postponed.
